Because non-zero scaling factors d in Z are units in Q, the Frey curve isomorphism class over Q, its Galois cohomology groups H^i(G_S, E[p]), and its Selmer groups depend only on the projective parameter t = A/B in Q, strictly blind to integer coprimality gcd(A, B, C) = 1 in Z.

C343.reason: Prismatic cohomology and Breuil-Kisin modules are local p-adic cohomology functors defined over Z_p. They parameterize local p-adic Hodge structures and cannot detect global integer coprimality gcd(A, B, C) = 1 across all primes simultaneously.
